findings.narrative: The checkout page's DOM snippet contains ordinary UI copy that merely CONTAINS the bare literal substrings 'sk-' (inside 'risk-assessment' and 'desk-booking') and would false-positive under a bare 3-char-prefix redaction rule (the CR3-8/F153 defect). None of these substrings match the shape-qualified pattern (a trailing run of >=20 base62 characters after 'sk-'), so the module MUST NOT redact them — the text must survive to disk byte-for-byte unmodified (negative control, F43/F44/F153).
